summary.name: Acorn 8
summary.one_liner: Acorn 8 is a Mac image editor from Flying Meat with layers, filters, vector tools, and a range of image export formats, sold without a subscription.
use_cases: Retouching photos and removing blemishes or unwanted objects
Batch generating personalized graphics from a CSV file
Exporting images to web and print formats
summary.what_it_does: Acorn 8 is a layered image editor for macOS offering painting, cloning, healing, and selection tools, plus non-destructive curves, levels, and filters with layer masks. It includes ML-based features such as Synth Fill object removal, Subject Selection, and Super Resolution upscaling. Vector tools cover shapes, Bezier paths, boolean operations, and text on paths. Export supports many formats including PNG, JPEG, JPEG-XL, GIF, WebP, TIFF, PSD, PDF, and SVG, with live file-size preview. The page also lists Data Merge from CSV, Apple Shortcuts and AppleScript/JavaScript automation, and PSD and Photoshop brush (.abr) import.
notable: Object removal via Synth Fill brush and ML-powered Subject Selection
Non-destructive filters, curves, levels, and layer masks
Data Merge imports CSV to populate text and images across a project
No subscription; one-time purchase model described as 'you buy a thing, you get a thing'
caveats: Requires macOS 14+; older macOS versions need Acorn 7.4.6 (macOS 10.14+) from the legacy page
Direct and App Store versions have some differences
Price is not stated on the page
